key.format: String(entry.id) of the thaqalayn-api.net entry (per-volume sequential id, 1..N); file chosen from the volume number in entry.bookId "Al-Kafi-Volume-<N>-Kulayni".
key.whyNotUrl: entry.URL (/hadith/<vol>/<book>/<chapter>/<hadith>) does NOT reliably equal the ThaqalaynData path: vol 1 uses book 0 / chapter 0 for the introduction, vol 6-8 use different chapter/hadith numbering, and vol 8 URLs are /1/<n>/<n>. The id is unique and sequential in every volume (verified 1..N), so it is the safest key; the mapping id -> ThaqalaynData hadith was built by aligning Arabic text (see README).
key.token: h[key].t = 4 hex chars = (FNV-1a-32 of the first 24 letters of norm(arabicText)) & 0xFFFF; recompute from the API entry and refuse the chain if it differs (guards against API id drift). norm() is specified in README / tools/isnad_key.js.

entryFields.c: ordered chain, as read in the hadith text (Kulayni side first, Infallible last). Items: {i:datasetNarratorId, n:English label (omitted if the dataset has none), a:Arabic as written in THIS hadith, r:1 if a back-reference such as "his father"/"from him"} or {t:"unlinked text inside the chain, e.g. رفعه / عمن ذكره / a name the dataset did not link"}
entryFields.g: hadith-level gradings from the dataset (Majlisi / Behbudi ...), NOT narrator reliability; omitted when none
entryFields.q: omitted = exact text match; 1 = matched by first+last 40 letters; 2 = fuzzy text match (chain text itself verified >= 90% similar to the API text)
